# Academy Management System (AMS) — Client

> Frontend client for the Academy Management System (AMS) dashboard. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5, CSS Modules, Base UI, and Style Dictionary design tokens.

## Architecture & Codebase Map
- `src/app/`: Next.js 16 App Router pages and layouts. Minimal route handlers only; no CSS modules.
- `src/features/dashboard/`: Dashboard feature slice containing components, services, types, and index export.
- `src/components/ui/`: Shared headless and styled UI primitives (badge, button, card, input).
- `src/components/layout/`: Global layout components (sidebar, topbar, dashboard shell).
- `src/components/not-found/`: Modular 404 page component with animated SVG.
- `src/styles/tokens.css`: Generated design token custom properties (`--ams-*`).
- `src/lib/touch-ripple.ts`: Material UI style touch ripple generator.

## Key Development Commands
- `pnpm dev`: Run local dev server on http://localhost:3000
- `pnpm typecheck`: Run TypeScript compiler type checking (`tsc --noEmit`)
- `pnpm lint`: Run ESLint checks
- `pnpm build`: Next.js production build

## Brand Colors & Themes
- Dhaka Specialty Coffee Academy (DSCA): `#028c4a`
- Global Barista Training Academy (GBTA): `#ff7724`
- Primary Brand Blue: `#1b84ff`
- Text Primary: `#071437`
- Text Muted: `#99a1b7`
